mcq_fix.s: According to the Economic Survey 2025-26, social protection in India covers approximately what share of the population?
Which one of the following is NOT generally regarded as a social welfare service?

mcq_drop.why: dubious: public borrowing is not a tax/subsidy instrument; typo 'incentive incentives'

patterns: APPSC PYQs here are social-welfare administration facts rather than policy theory: CSWB creche scheme, AP Social Welfare Fund (1975), MoSJE budget, social protection programmes (RSBY).
Odd-one-out and 'which is a social protection programme' shapes recur; ministry evolution years (MoSJE 1998) are asked directly.
No PYQ tests the policy cycle or policy thinkers (Lowi, Lindblom, Lipsky); the app has many theory match items, more UPSC/academic in depth.
Distractors are usually look-alike scheme acronyms (NRHM, BRGF, RSBY).
